data.title: 雅儿贝德 · 廊檐下等雨停
data.description: 阵雨把露天石阶打湿了。雅儿贝德在廊檐下停住，一手将白缎后摆拢到身侧，免得拖过积水。雨线从檐角慢慢细下去，她抬头，蕾丝头纱垂在角后。
data.action: 拢住身侧的裙摆，抬头看雨线从檐边变细
data.lighting: 廊外散射天光与石阶反光
data.camera: 回廊侧后方全身，头纱和拖尾同框
data.promptProse: Albedo waits beneath a stone arcade in a white satin wedding gown. She gathers the train to one side before stepping onto the wet stairs and looks up as rain thins beyond the eaves. A lace veil falls behind her horns, and the damp stones reflect the dim evening light.
data.animaCaption: She waits at the dry edge of the stairs, holding her satin train clear of the rainwater.
